To begin with, finding the theatre was quite confusing. There were no boards, signs, or posters indicating that a theatre was located there. My cab dropped me right in front of the building, but I still couldn’t see any clear markings to confirm I was at the right place.

Next, after completing the ticket check and heading upstairs, I noticed there were very few seats available for waiting. Only about ten people could sit on a sofa, and the rest had to stand until roughly ten minutes before the show began. So, if you arrive early, be prepared to wait standing.

Another issue — (Screen 2) avoid seats D19 and D20 in the upper section. Your view will be blocked by a gypsum board placed directly in front.

The seating overall is not very comfortable, especially for back support. The sound quality was also below expectations, lacking smoothness and clarity.

Like in many theatres, disturbances were present: people searching for seats with mobile flashlights after the movie started, crying babies, phone conversations, latecomers, people recording videos, and vendors distributing popcorn mid-show etc.

Speaking of popcorn — I paid ₹460 for one serving and ₹70 for a half-litre bottle of mineral water. Including my travel, I spent around ₹1,500 just to watch a movie.

Finally, a serious safety concern: when exiting after the show, you must use the stairs. Some steps are partially damaged, making it risky to walk in a crowd. Today, I even witnessed a man fall while carrying a small child because of the broken steps. Please be cautious.

featured_reviews.name: Venkat Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text: I saw it from outside and came to know what would be inside. I was a resident of Chembur from 1960 to 1991. I still remember, during the 60s, it was pride of Chembur as it was the only air conditioned  theatre in the area and going there to watch any movie with family and friends was a great pleasure for all. AC was very powerful, seats very comfortable, picture and sound quality excellent, canteen used to serve tasty samosas, snacks and beverages at reasonable prices. Management was talking pains to maintain the ambience and decor. But over the period, due to poor management, improper maintenance, the quality deteriorated gradually and it has come to the present stage. Added to all these, competition from multiplexes has caused further damage. Most surprising is still it continues to run against all odds is something great. I doubt will there be any scope for improvement. The best option will be to sell the land to some potential builder who can build Shopping mall or residential tower, as the place is strategically located (very close to railway station and bus stop ). Rest is left to God.

featured_reviews.name: Parikshit Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited MovieTime Cinemas at Hub Mall with a group of friends on a Friday, expecting a good movie experience, but it turned out to be quite disappointing.

The experience started on a positive note. The security staff were welcoming, the common area was clean, and there were plenty of food options available. However, the popcorn wasn’t worth the price.

What surprised us even more was that the auditorium wasn’t cleaned after the previous show empty popcorn tubs, Coke cups, and other litter were still lying around. There were even mosquitoes and flies inside the hall, which completely ruined the overall experience.

The only reason I’m not giving a one-star rating is because the screen quality and sound system were actually quite good.

For a theatre in a mall, basic hygiene and maintenance should never be compromised. I sincerely hope the management focuses on cleaning the auditoriums and renovating the seating, as the current condition is far below expectations.

Cleanliness: 1/5
Seat Comfort: 1/5
Screen Quality: 3/5
Sound Quality: 3/5
Food & Beverages: 2/5
Staff: 4/5
Value for Money: 2/5

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐

Good screen and sound can’t make up for poor hygiene, broken seats, and an unpleasant auditorium. A complete maintenance upgrade is urgently needed.

featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Cinema – Oberoi Mall, Mumbai

I recently visited PVR Cinema at Oberoi Mall, Mumbai, and had a fantastic overall experience. Of course, the cinema itself lives up to the PVR standard – clean, comfortable seating, great sound and picture quality, and a well-maintained ambiance. But what really caught me by surprise this time was the food.

We decided to try the hotdogs, and honestly, they were far better than the typical movie-snack expectations. The buns were perfectly steamed – soft, warm, and fresh – which made a big difference in texture. The sausage was juicy and flavorful, and they nailed the condiment-to-meat ratio. Nothing was overly messy or underwhelming – just a really well-balanced, satisfying bite that felt thoughtfully put together rather than rushed.

Another nice touch was the small Costa Coffee counter inside the cinema area. It’s not a full café, but they do serve the essentials. We ordered an iced latte, and it was surprisingly good – strong but not bitter, with just the right amount of milk and ice. It was a refreshing complement to the hot food and added to the overall premium feel of the experience.

All in all, PVR Oberoi Mall offers more than just movies – it’s clearly putting effort into creating a quality experience across the board, including the food and beverage options. Whether you’re here for a blockbuster or just want a relaxed evening out, this location delivers on multiple fronts. Definitely looking forward to going back.

featured_reviews.review_text: Fun Republic Mall has been a part of my life since 2015, and watching it change over the years feels deeply personal to me. Back then, the mall had a completely different vibe, yet it always felt lively and comforting. I watched movies there during some of the best phases of my life, and even today, I still return for the same feeling of familiarity and nostalgia. Over the years, I saw places come and go, brands change, and the entire atmosphere slowly evolve. From Dohi to Si Noonas, from Slingshot to Queen’s Margarita, I witnessed every transformation closely. Each place carried its own memories, energy, and crowd, making the mall feel like a timeline of my growing years. Even though many things have changed, Fun Republic still feels connected to my past. Every visit reminds me of old friendships, unforgettable conversations, and carefree moments that can never truly be recreated anywhere else. It will always remain one of the most nostalgic places in my life. No matter how modern it becomes, the memories attached to it will always feel timeless to me

Between shows, there are endless stories—first dates, birthday plans, late-night shows, and post-movie discussions that matter more than the movie itself. For Mumbaikars, INOX Inorbit isn’t just about watching films, it’s about living those little moments that make city life fun and filmy. 🎬✨

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this Inox to watch F1 in 4DX. Although the was inox was impeccably clean and well designed,the 4DX effects weren't quite impressive. There were unnecessary seat pushes throughout the movie (almost all the racing scenes) which actually didn't let us focus our eyes on the screen. Two flashlights placed in the hall that threw light at us for nothing and the air blower system that was triggered in just one instance where it was absolutely unnecessary. 4DX is supposed to make the movie watching experience immersive but I guess F1 didn't need an additional 4DX. Still rating the screen a 5 star as the effects could have been better for other movies.
Restrooms were clean and neat as any other INOX. Drinking water with paper cups were placed. There was luckily no disturbance from the staff during or after the interval for their snacks. The chairs allotted were otherwise very comfortable and spacious enough to watch a movie. We had a pleasant time during our movie here. There's also a separate kid's theater and a small hall exclusive for hosting birthday parties at the Inox.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Cinépolis is one of the most popular multiplex chains in Mumbai, known for its sleek, modern design and high-end cinematic technology. Whether you are visiting the one in Andheri, Thane, or Navi Mumbai, the vibe is consistently premium. It’s a top-tier choice for movie-goers who prioritize comfort, crystal-clear visuals, and a great atmosphere for a day out with friends or family.
Pros:
Superior Comfort: The seating is well-spaced with excellent legroom. If you opt for the VIP or IMAX screens, the leather recliners are incredibly cozy.
Cutting-Edge Tech: They use advanced laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound systems, making the action feel very immersive.
Variety of Formats: Depending on the location, you can choose from 4DX (moving seats/effects), IMAX, or their luxury "Coffee Tree" service.
Cleanliness: The lobbies and washrooms are generally well-maintained and have a "high-class" feel.
Cons:
Expensive Concessions: Like most premium malls, the popcorn and sodas are quite pricey—sometimes costing more than the movie ticket itself!
Peak Hour Crowds: During big blockbuster releases or weekends, the lobby can get very crowded, leading to long queues at the security check and food counters.
Parking Fees: Since most Cinépolis theaters are inside major malls, you’ll have to pay the standard (and sometimes steep) mall parking rates.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A Luxurious Cinema Experience: Inox Insignia Review

I recently had the pleasure of watching a movie at Inox Insignia, located inside the popular Inorbit Mall, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The moment we stepped into the theater, we were impressed by the sleek and modern decor, which set the tone for a luxurious cinema experience.

The recliner seats at Inox Insignia are a game-changer - every seat in the house is a plush, comfortable recliner, allowing you to sink in and relax while enjoying your movie. The sound quality was impeccable, and the screen was crystal clear, making every scene feel immersive and engaging.

But what really elevated our experience was the food. We tried a variety of items from the menu, and each one was a delight. The Iced Latte from the Costa kiosk was a perfect pick-me-up, with just the right amount of caffeine and flavor. The Chicken Hotdog was juicy and flavorful, with a nice snap to the hotdog. The Loaded Nachos were a highlight, with a generous helping of cheese, salsa, and jalapenos. And the Mac and Cheese was creamy and comforting, with a nice crunch from the topping.

The service was also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who ensured that our needs were met throughout the movie. The theater was clean and well-maintained, with a nice ambiance that added to the overall experience.

Being located inside Inorbit Mall, Inox Insignia offers the perfect combination of entertainment, dining, and shopping. You can catch a movie, grab a bite to eat at one of the many restaurants or food courts, and then browse through the various stores and shops - all under one roof.

Overall, I would highly recommend Inox Insignia to anyone looking for a luxurious and enjoyable movie experience. The recliner seats, delicious food, and excellent service make it a standout among other cinemas. Whether you're a movie buff or just looking for a fun night out, Inox Insignia is definitely worth a visit.

Rating: 5/5
Tips and Recommendations:
•  Try the Loaded Nachos and Mac and Cheese - they're delicious!
•  Don't miss the Iced Latte from the Costa kiosk - it's a perfect pick-me-up.
•  Arrive early to grab a good seat and enjoy the pre-movie ambiance.
•  Take advantage of the mall's amenities, such as the food court, restaurants, and shops, to make a day of it.
•  Be sure to check out the various promotions and offers available, as they can add even more value to your experience.

Inox Insignia has set a new standard for cinema experiences, and I look forward to returning soon to enjoy another movie in style!

I recently visited Harmony Mall, and it was a pleasant experience overall.
The mall is well-maintained, clean, and has a decent variety of stores and eateries to explore. It’s not too crowded, which makes walking around and shopping comfortable. The ambiance is modern and inviting, creating a relaxed vibe for families and individuals alike.

featured_reviews.name: Digital Dhruv Rampariya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Harmony Mall is a small and budget-friendly mall in Goregaon West, mainly known for its convenience and basic facilities rather than a full shopping experience.

The mall is located in a prime area near Oshiwara, making it easily accessible. It has a cinema (Carnival Cinemas) and a few offices, along with some basic amenities like cafes and small stores.

However, over time, the mall has lost its charm and feels more like a commercial complex than a proper mall. Many shops are either closed or converted into office spaces, so there isn’t much to explore.

Cleanliness and maintenance are major concerns—washrooms and common areas are often not well maintained, and the overall infrastructure feels outdated.

On the positive side, it’s useful for quick visits, watching a movie, or office-related work. But if you’re looking for a lively shopping or entertainment experience, this might not be the best choice.

Overall: A basic, utility-focused place—good for specific needs, but not for hangouts or premium shopping.
